title: LibraryHub
subtitle: Library management system
sideText: Keep a library catalogue in one place
description: LibraryHub is a library management app I built as a demo for a presentation. A library needs one place to add books, keep copy counts current and find a title quickly, and the demo had to run anywhere with no server to set up. An admin signs in, sees the total book count on a dashboard and manages the catalogue in a list of books, or bulk-imports books from an Excel or CSV file. All data lives in the browser's localStorage, seeded with sample books, so there is no backend.
impact: A complete admin flow from sign-in to catalogue: add, edit, view and delete books, search by title or author, and filter by category and availability. The bulk importer reads messy spreadsheets by working out which column is which from the headers and the data itself, and shows the detected mapping before anything is imported.
tags: Add, edit, view and delete books

howItWorks.title: Sign in
howItWorks.description: An admin logs in with the demo credentials shown on the login page (admin@libraryhub.com / admin123). The session is kept in localStorage.

howItWorks.title: Manage books
howItWorks.description: The dashboard shows the total book count and the list of books. Each book has a title, author, category, total copies, available copies, year and cover URL, and can be added, edited, viewed or deleted, with a confirmation before delete.

howItWorks.title: Find books
howItWorks.description: Search by title or author, and filter by category and by availability (in stock or out of stock).

howItWorks.title: Bulk import
howItWorks.description: Upload an Excel or CSV file and SheetJS reads it. Columns are detected with fuzzy header matching and content checks, even on sheets with no header row. Sr No, ISBN, price and publisher columns are ignored, and the detected mapping is shown before import.
